screening.reason: Exclusion 3: ABIDE I and II data used only for a structural-MRI (voxel-based-morphometry grey-matter asymmetry / normative-model) replication analysis; no resting-state functional analysis of ABIDE data is reported.

evidence_quotes: we selected a sample from the publically available Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and II (50,51) to examine extreme right- and leftward deviations in an independent datasets.
